neighbours.label: the word after a presentational 'Here' that announces upcoming content (Here is / Here's what / Here are)
fire: The forecast changed overnight. Here is the latest update from the weather service.
I asked three chefs for advice. Here's what they told me:
The committee met on Friday. Here are the main decisions it reached.
Several fans sent in photos. Here is a selection of the best ones.
We finally finished the garden. Here's how it looks now.
You asked for the recipe. Here is the full list of ingredients you will need.
The data surprised us. Here's why it matters.
Our guide explained the history of the castle. Here are a few highlights.
quiet: The forecast changed overnight. The weather service issued an update.
I asked three chefs for advice. They told me to rest the dough.
The committee met on Friday and reached several decisions.
Several fans sent in photos, and we liked most of them.
We finally finished the garden. It looks lovely now.
You asked for the recipe. It needs flour, eggs and milk.
The data surprised us because the trend reversed.
Our guide explained the history of the castle in great detail.

notes: Card: 'Here is a contemporary account', 'here's what', 'Here are some images', 'the following'. Probe: Here's what 0.387, Here is a summary 0.298, locative 'Here we stayed' 0.181 (on Here), Here are the results only 0.066; declarative controls 0.009-0.027.
